title: still present since round 4: EXEMPT_ARMS trusts comments over code for 17 arms — removing a claimed guard keeps the lint green
evidence: lint_demo_network.py:42-44: `# Message arms whose real api calls are structurally unreachable in demo mode # (auth flows always exit the demo first; ApiReturnedSession/PolicyRefresh are # demo-guarded at the top of their handlers). EXEMPT_ARMS = {` (17 entries, verified by count) — check_client skips them with no structural verification: `if ( scope_name in EXEMPT_ARMS or scope_name in DEMO_INTERCEPTED or scope_name in NEVER_PRODUCED ): continue`
detail: The ApiReturnedSession/PolicyRefresh comment is now true (both guarded), but nothing verifies it: deleting either handler's demo guard leaves the lint green. UserAcceptedPolicy is exempt without any guard.
recommended_fix: For arms claimed 'demo-guarded at the top', require the guard structurally (same matcher); for auth-flow arms, verify the arm exits demo before any api call or intercept them in demo_update.

title: still present since round 4: manifest matcher counts any capitalized constructor line in handle bodies as 'handled' (theoretical masking)
evidence: lint_demo_network.py:276-280 (check_demo_update_manifest): `m = re.match(r"^([A-Z][A-Za-z0-9_]+)(\(| ->| \||$)", stripped) if m:     handled.add(m.group(1)) for alt in re.findall(r"\|\s*([A-Z][A-Za-z0-9_]+)(\(| ->|$)", stripped):     handled.add(alt[0])` — the scan is depth-tracked only for the outer case's closing brace; nested case patterns inside an arm body also match and are added to `handled`.
detail: A nested `Some(Msg) ->` style pattern or an inner-case constructor line inside any arm inflates `handled`, so DEMO_INTERCEPTED can claim a message demo_update never actually intercepts at the top level.
recommended_fix: Only collect constructor patterns at the case's immediate arm depth (reset a per-arm depth counter after each `->`), or parse arms strictly between depth 1 and 2.
